items.summary: Reject the proposed control-plane specifications, production work, requeues, new telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization expansion, and unsupported financial claims this cycle. The authoritative candidate list is empty; 47 repair follow-ups remain open, 28 improvements await measurement, and only 2 outcomes are proven. Revenue is limited to one dated aggregate window, with no site-attributed commission or supported ROI. Continue existing repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence only. Keep public launch gates unchanged and external outreach unsent.

Retain the three workflow concepts as deferred backlog only. Do not create duplicate proposals or implementation requests. Preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed; treat traffic, rankings, conversions, technical scores, and AI usage as operating metrics rather than financial returns. Existing security evidence work may continue read-only using authorized metadata and retained artifacts.
